```{r, include=FALSE}
## saved tables and figures from 01-04; a message instead of an error if results are out of date
show_table <- function(ft) {
  validate(need(!is.null(ft), "Table not found. Rerun 05_render_report.R to update the results."))
  ft %>%
    set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1) %>%
    htmltools_value()
}

show_figure <- function(fig) {
  validate(need(!is.null(fig), "Figure not found. Rerun 05_render_report.R to update the results."))
  fig
}

fmt_ci <- function(est, lo, hi, digits = 2) {
  sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f (%.", digits, "f to %.", digits, "f)"), est, lo, hi)
}

group_choices <- c("Sex" = "sex", "Age group" = "age_group", "BMI category" = "bmi_category")

bmi_levels <- levels(sbp$sbp_long$bmi_category)
age_levels <- levels(sbp$sbp_long$age_group)

predict_sbp <- function(newdata) {
  X  <- model.matrix(~ years * (age_c10 + sex + bmi_category) + bp_med, data = newdata)
  X  <- X[, names(sbp$fixef), drop = FALSE]
  se <- sqrt(rowSums((X %*% sbp$vcov) * X))
  
  newdata %>%
    mutate(
      fit   = as.vector(X %*% sbp$fixef),
      lower = fit - 1.96 * se,
      upper = fit + 1.96 * se
    )
}
```


# Dataset Description 

- **My GitHub Repo**
  - https://github.com/MOI13/Hypressure

- **Dataset**
  - Synthetic cohort of `r format(qc$qc$Count[qc$qc$Step == "Participants"], big.mark = ",")` adults with `r format(qc$qc$Count[qc$qc$Step == "Visits in the analysis dataset"], big.mark = ",")` visits, including an entry visit, scheduled clinic visits (months 12 to 84), home visits, and unofficial visits.
  - Hypertension: blood pressure ≥130/80 mmHg or antihypertensive medication use.

```{r}
renderPlotly({
  
  p <- onset$cum_inc %>%
    filter(group_var == input$onset_group) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = time, y = cum_inc, color = group)) +
    geom_step() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
    scale_color_strata(input$onset_group) +
    labs(x = "Years since entry", y = "Cumulative incidence of hypertension", color = NULL) +
    theme_journal()

  ggplotly(p)
})
```

# 4. SBP Change

## Column {.sidebar data-width="350"}

**Question**

`r sbp$question`

**Key Takeaways**

`r sbp$answer`

---

**Predicted SBP, custom settings**

```{r}
selectInput("pred_color", "Compare:", 
            choices = c(group_choices, "BP medication start" = "med_start"))

## a setting is hidden while it is the factor being compared
conditionalPanel(
  "input.pred_color != 'age_group'",
  sliderInput("pred_age", "Age at entry:", min = 20, max = 85, value = 50, step = 5)
)

conditionalPanel(
  "input.pred_color != 'sex'",
  radioButtons("pred_sex", "Sex:", choices = c("Female", "Male"), inline = TRUE)
)

conditionalPanel(
  "input.pred_color != 'bmi_category'",
  selectInput("pred_bmi", "BMI category:", choices = bmi_levels, selected = "Normal weight")
)

conditionalPanel(
  "input.pred_color != 'med_start'",
  selectInput("pred_med", "Starts BP medication:", 
              choices = c("Never during follow-up" = "never", "At entry" = "0", 
                          "At year 1" = "1", "At year 2" = "2", "At year 3" = "3",
                          "At year 4" = "4", "At year 5" = "5", "At year 6" = "6"))
)
```

The compared factor shows all its groups, and its setting is hidden; the other settings apply to every line.

### Predicted SBP, Custom Settings

```{r}
renderPlotly({
  
  settings <- tibble(
    age_c10      = (input$pred_age - 50) / 10,
    sex          = factor(input$pred_sex, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    bmi_category = factor(input$pred_bmi, levels = bmi_levels),
    med_start    = if (input$pred_med == "never") Inf else as.numeric(input$pred_med)
  )

  compare <- switch(input$pred_color,
    age_group    = tibble(age_c10 = (c(25, 35, 45, 55, 70) - 50) / 10, group = age_levels),
    sex          = tibble(sex = factor(c("Female", "Male"), levels = c("Female", "Male")), group = c("Female", "Male")),
    bmi_category = tibble(bmi_category = factor(bmi_levels, levels = bmi_levels), group = bmi_levels),
    med_start    = tibble(med_start = c(Inf, 0:6), group = names(med_start_colors))
  )

  plot_data <- expand_grid(
    settings %>% select(-any_of(names(compare))),
    compare,
    years = seq(0, 7, by = 0.25)
  ) %>%
    mutate(bp_med = as.numeric(years >= med_start)) %>%
    predict_sbp()

  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = years, y = fit, color = group, fill = group)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.06, color = NA) +
    geom_line(aes(text = paste("\n", group, 
                               "\nYear:", years, 
                               "\nPredicted SBP:", fmt_ci(fit, lower, upper, digits = 1)),
                  group = group)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:7) +
    scale_color_strata(input$pred_color) +
    scale_fill_strata(input$pred_color) +
    labs(x = "Years since entry", y = "Predicted SBP, mmHg (95% CI)", color = NULL, fill = NULL) +
    theme_journal()

  ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
})
```
